phase_name: ko subcommand with runtime project-key resolution

objectives.description: Implement ko --note [...] [--project cid] with runtime key resolution
Reuse sapience-remember.sh's four-check loud-failure order verbatim

deviations.description: ko --note <text> [...] interface: the plan specifies only --note and --project flags, without pinning down the resulting KO's subject/predicate/ko_type/confidence
deviations.reason: Filled in the underspecified detail: each --note becomes one KO's object_value, with subject='finding', predicate='finding is', ko_type='insight', confidence=0.8 -- all defaulted exactly as sapience-remember.sh defaults them, since the plan gives ko a deliberately simpler multi-note CLI than sapience-remember.sh's single-note --subject/--value interface. No plan verification criterion checks the subject field's content, so this choice does not affect pass/fail of any named check.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- subject/predicate/ko_type/confidence defaults filled in, not specified by the plan)*
